system.description: A Droid sometimes needs to be stowed in places where it usually would not fit. For example, a Droid stowed in a smaller cargo space might surprise an enemy. The Collapsible Construction modification allows a Droid to lower its size category by one when it shuts down. The Droid Brain enters stand-by mode while it compacts itself into a smaller size. The Droid can reactivate at any time as a Standard Action.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
